about: Entry requirements of the graduate-entry master's courses cited by the route gates (does a bachelor in an unrelated field get in?), and the instrument that lists occupations for the 485 Post-Vocational Education Work stream. Quotes are copied word for word from the official course page / legislation text.

uqNursingMaster.quote: To be eligible for entry, you'll need: a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in any discipline. You must have a grade point average (GPA) of 4.0 on a 7-point scale in your previous qualification.Your previous qualification must have been completed within the last 10 years

value.course: Adelaide University Master of Midwifery (Graduate Entry)
value.nonHealthNeeds: 12 units (0.250 EFTSL) of human anatomy and physiology at AQF 7+

adelaideMidwiferyMaster.quote: A completed bachelor degree (AQF level 7) or higher in a health-related field from a recognised higher education institution; OR A completed bachelor degree (AQF level 7) or higher in a non-health field from a recognised higher education institution, plus the equivalent of 12 units (0.250 EFTSL) of dedicated Human Anatomy and Physiology undertaken at AQF Level 7 (bachelor degree level) or higher.

value.needs: university-level human anatomy and human physiology

uqPhysioMaster.quote: A bachelor's degree (or equivalent), with completed university-level studies in human anatomy and human physiology. Please see 'Additional application information' below for further details on entry requirements. You must have a grade point average (GPA) of 4.5 on a 7-point scale in your previous qualification.

value.course: University of Sydney Master of Occupational Therapy
value.nonHealthNote: must take prescribed anatomy and/or psychology units as selectives within the course

usydOtMaster.quote: (2) Admission to candidature for the Master of Occupational Therapy requires: (a) a PhD, masters or bachelors degree from an Australian institution or equivalent, and (b) evidence of any other minimum standards specified by the Faculty of Medicine and Health. (3) Applicants without a degree in a health related area such as medicine, nursing, allied health or health sciences or human functioning (education, anthropology, anthropometrics, built environment) must complete prescribed units of study in anatomy and/or psychology as selectives.

value.course: UTS Master of Speech Pathology C04386 (Autumn B 2027 intake page)

utsSpMaster.quote: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.75/7 AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, interest in speech pathology, and commitment to speech pathology as a career (assessed through an interview)

value.needs: relevant discipline with one year FTE of social and behavioural sciences

uqSwMaster.quote: A bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline (see below), with one year, full-time equivalent study in social and behavioural sciences. You must have a grade point average (GPA) of 4.0 on a 7-point scale in your previous qualification.

value.needs: three-year bachelor meeting the prerequisites of the chosen teaching areas

unswMTeachSecondary.quote: Undergraduate degree: A recognised three-year Bachelor degree which meets the prerequisites for their selected teaching methods/specialisation/s. Minimum WAM: 60/100 (or equivalent).

value.course: University of Melbourne Master of Construction Management (MC-CM)

unimelbMCM.quote: Have completed a bachelor degree (AQF7) in any discipline with a weighted average mark (WAM) of 65%, or equivalent.

value.needs: designed for managers with at least three years professional experience; domestic entry requires three years managerial/professional work

mqMBA.quote: Our MBA program is designed for managers with at least three years professional experience.

value.course: University of Sydney Master of Professional Engineering
value.nonEngineeringNeeds: 48 credit points of mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geology, computing or statistics related to the stream

usydMPE.quote: (b) a non-engineering bachelor's degree with a minimum credit average, with studies equivalent to 48 credit points in mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geology, computing or statistics, as related to the stream sought for admission.

value.excluded: IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, interaction design, multimedia design

uqMIT.quote: a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a field  other than  information technology, computer science, software/computer engineering, interaction design or multimedia design. You must have a grade point average (GPA) of 5.0 on a 7-point scale in your previous qualification.

value.course: UNSW Master of Professional Accounting 8409, CRICOS 051221J
value.note: designed for graduates with no or limited accounting studies; credit average

unswMPA.quote: Recognised bachelor degree (or equivalent qualification) with a credit average as determined by the UNSW Postgraduate Coursework Entry Score Calculator . Notes: This degree is designed for graduates with no or limited accounting studies.

value.instrument: Migration (LIN 19/051: Specification of Occupations and Relevant Assessing Authorities) Instrument 2019
value.compilation: Compilation No. 5, F2026C00265, in force from 2026-03-28
value.rule: For persons applying for a Subclass 485 visa the applicable list is the Medium and Longterm Strategic Skills List (s 7(1) item 2), and each occupation on it is specified as a skilled occupation for paragraph 1229(3)(k) (s 7(6)(b))
